title: Summer Fit Rush — Activewear & Athleisure School Holiday Campaign
objective: Capture school holiday spending surge (4–6 weeks peak) with youth-focused activewear content that drives online + in-store traffic and builds summer wardrobe intent.
target_audience: Students 12–25, parents buying for kids, young professionals refreshing summer wardrobes
key_activities: 7-week social content calendar (reels, carousels, Stories) tied to holiday phases (Week 1: back-to-school; Week 2–3: staycation prep; Week 4–6: lifestyle clips)
3 micro-influencer collaborations (each 2–3 posts, 50k–150k followers each) styling summer fits in real locations (HDB estate, mall, East Coast Park)
Meta + TikTok paid ads (carousel ads, reels, TikTok For You placements) targeting 15–25 age group + parents of 12–18
In-store POS tie-in (QR codes linking to exclusive discount codes, tracked per location)
Weekly performance dashboard (reach, engagement, click-through, sales attribution)
kpis: 800+ new Instagram followers (organic + paid)
12% average engagement rate on reels (vs SG fashion benchmark 4–6%)
2,500+ link clicks to e-commerce landing page
25% uplift in summer activewear category sales vs June baseline
≥3 influencer posts achieving 5,000+ engagement each
why_now: School holidays (June 24–July 28) drive peak youth + family spending in SG. Back-to-school + staycation wardrobe refreshes create a 7-week high-intent window. Competitors are already running holiday campaigns — early July action secures prime influencer slots and ad inventory.
deliverables: Content calendar (49 posts: 14 reels, 14 carousels, 21 Stories)
3 influencer brief packages + performance contracts
5 hero product photos (lifestyle + flat-lay)
2 × 15s brand bumper ads (e-commerce + in-store discount messaging)
Weekly performance reports (6 weeks) with spend + ROAS breakdown

title: The Summer Store — Pop-Up Retail Event & Brand Immersion
objective: Create a 10-day summer pop-up retail experience in a high-traffic mall that combines product showcase, social media wall, and live try-on stations — driving foot traffic, in-store conversion, and earned media.
target_audience: Holiday shoppers (families + teens), Instagram-savvy 18–35, mall visitors seeking experience beyond transaction
key_activities: Pop-up space design (150 sqm, 2 zones: product showcase + photo lounge with branded backdrop + social wall)
Live demonstrations daily (10:00–21:00): styling sessions with in-house brand ambassadors, 15-min slots
Instagram-worthy photo stations with custom props (holiday-themed dressing room, neon signs, selfie moments) + hashtag campaign (#SummerStoreChallenge)
Real-time social wall displaying geotagged posts from visitors
Daily Instagram Stories + Reels from the pop-up (behind-the-scenes, customer reactions, styling tips)
In-pop-up exclusive offer (20% off, valid only at pop-up, tracked via QR code)
kpis: 1,200+ visitors over 10-day run (tracked via entry log)
≥350 items sold at pop-up (incremental to baseline store)
2,500+ #SummerStoreChallenge posts (UGC generated)
15M+ impressions across Instagram Stories + earned media
12% conversion rate (visitors → purchasers)
≥800 email subscribers captured via pop-up sign-up
why_now: July school holidays drive peak mall foot traffic in SG. Pop-ups are high-impact during holiday season when families are active shoppers. 10-day window (early–mid-July) captures 2–3 weekend cohorts of peak visitors. Real estate at major malls (Orchard, VivoCity, JEM) is available post-June rush.
deliverables: Pop-up space design (2D floor plan + 3D render)
Custom backdrop + photo booth installation + neon signage (branded)
10-day social content (daily Stories + 3× Reels)
3 brand ambassador briefing packs + daily talking points
Event day photography (200+ curated images)
Post-event report: footfall, conversion, UGC analysis, media reach

title: Flash Friday Frenzy — 6-Week Performance Digital Campaign
objective: Drive incremental e-commerce sales via a structured paid-media sprint across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with daily optimization and product-level performance tracking. Target cost-per-acquisition (CPA) and maximize July's high-intent shopping mood.
target_audience: E-commerce shoppers 18–45, cart abandoners, high-value repeat customers, look-alike audiences from top purchasers
key_activities: Campaign architecture: 3 phases (Awareness: broad reach, July 1–7; Consideration: retargeting + custom audiences, July 8–21; Conversion: high-intent, July 22–31)
Meta ads (Carousel, DPA, Collection): 4 daily ad sets rotating 8 hero products
Google Shopping: feed optimization, bid strategy (target ROAS 3:1 or better)
TikTok For You: 3 native-style product reels, 15-sec demo + humor, geo-targeted
Email retargeting: 3 abandoned-cart campaigns (trigger-based, sent 2h + 24h + 48h post-abandonment)
Daily optimization: pause underperformers (CTR <0.8%, CPC >$0.80), scale winners (ROAS >3:1)
kpis: 3:1 or better ROAS (Revenue ÷ Ad Spend)
Cost-per-acquisition ≤ $8 (vs SG e-commerce benchmark $10–15)
15% click-through rate (Meta + TikTok combined)
2,500+ add-to-cart events
18% email conversion rate on retargeting (vs baseline 8%)
≥$40,000 incremental revenue attributed to campaign
why_now: July is SG's highest e-commerce month post-June (school holidays, mid-year bonuses clearing, staycation spending). User intent signals are 30–40% higher than May baseline. Ad CPMs are slightly lower mid-July as competitors scale back post-Father's Day.
deliverables: Campaign strategy deck (audience segments, bid strategy, creative rotation plan)
8 product carousel ads (Meta) + 4 product Reels (TikTok) + 2 Google Shopping feeds
3 email sequences (abandoned cart, post-purchase upsell, re-engagement)
Daily performance updates (Slack) + weekly optimization reports
Post-campaign ROI analysis: product-level ROAS, cohort LTV, channel attribution

title: Back in Style — Fashion/Apparel Rebrand Launch Event + Social Sprint
objective: Introduce refreshed brand identity (logo, color palette, tagline, positioning) to press, influencers, and core audience via a hybrid launch event (physical + digital) and 8-week social campaign. Establish new brand narrative and refresh customer perception.
target_audience: Fashion-forward 20–45, existing customers, lifestyle influencers (50k–500k followers), fashion & lifestyle media (SG/MY tier-2 publications), e-commerce early adopters
key_activities: Launch event (afternoon cocktail, 100–120 guests): press preview, influencer styling lounge, brand founders interview (recorded for content), guided tour of new store aesthetic
Press kit: brand story film (2 min, cinematic), brand guidelines one-pager, founder quote sheet, product photography (new collection + rebrand)
Influencer seeding: 5 mid-tier influencers (75k–250k followers) receive exclusive gifting + content brief (post requirement: 1 Reel + 3 carousel posts over 4 weeks)
8-week owned social campaign: brand story arc (Week 1–2: evolution narrative; Week 3–4: product hero shots; Week 5–6: community features; Week 7–8: seasonal integration)
Paid amplification: Meta + TikTok targeting lookalike + warm audiences, 20% of budget to influencer content reshares
kpis: 80+ media mentions (print, online, trade publications) in first 3 weeks
1,200+ event attendees (tracked via registration)
5 influencer posts averaging 8,000+ engagement each (combined reach 1.2M+)
2,500+ new Instagram followers (organic growth post-launch)
15% lift in online store traffic (vs June baseline) sustained through week 8
≥500 email signups captured at event + social CTAs
why_now: July positioning allows 2–3 weeks of post-launch momentum before school holidays end (early Sept) and summer sales campaigns dominate. Media cycles are slower in July, making tier-2 features more accessible. Influencers are most active during school holidays with higher engagement rates.
deliverables: Rebrand launch event (full run-of-show, AV + staging, photography, 1 highlight video)
Brand story film (2 min, cinematic, 4K, delivered as long-form + social cuts)
Press kit (digital + print): brand guidelines, fact sheet, hi-res product photography (50+ images)
5 influencer brief packs + contracts + performance tracking dashboard
Social content calendar (56 posts over 8 weeks: 16 Reels, 24 carousels, 16 Stories)
Weekly media monitoring + engagement reports (8 weeks)

title: Summer Sale Sprint — Time-Sensitive Lead Generation Campaign
objective: Generate 300+ qualified leads (emails + phone) for a clearance / summer sale event (limited-time offer, July 15–31). Use urgency mechanics, landing page optimization, and retargeting to drive high-intent traffic and capture buyer information for post-sale nurture.
target_audience: Deal-hungry shoppers 25–55, newsletter subscribers, website visitors from past 90 days, search intent (e.g., 'summer sale SG', 'discounted apparel'), look-alike to high-value purchasers
key_activities: High-converting landing page (1 page, mobile-first): hero countdown timer, social proof (testimonials, stock count), form field optimization (minimal friction: email + phone only), benefit-focused copy (% off, free shipping, time limit messaging)
Paid media blitz: Google Ads (search intent + shopping), Meta + TikTok (carousel + video), 70% budget to retargeting (site visitors, email list, lookalike)
Email nurture: 3 pre-sale teasers (Days 1–5), launch day email (sale live + urgency), 2 mid-period reminder emails (stock depletion hook)
SMS retargeting (opt-in list): 2 flash alerts ('Last 48 hours', 'Final call')
Daily performance optimization: pause low-ROAS placements, reallocate to winners, A/B test CTA button text + landing page headlines
kpis: 300+ qualified leads captured (emails + phone, deduplicated)
Cost-per-lead ≤ $18 (blended across channels)
4% landing page conversion rate (visitors → form submissions)
8% email open rate on launch email (vs list average 3–4%)
2,000+ page visits (organic + paid combined)
45% of leads purchasing within 7 days post-capture (lead quality metric)
why_now: Mid-to-late July is peak clearance season in SG (school holidays + summer changeover). Shoppers are actively searching for deals. 2-week sale window (July 15–31) creates urgency and time-decay pressure, boosting form-submission rates. Email list fatigue is lower in July pre-August sales bombardment.
deliverables: High-converting landing page (desktop + mobile optimized, 1 CMS page, live hosting)
3 paid media creative sets (10 banner ads, 4 video ads for TikTok/Meta, 2 Google search ads)
3 pre-sale + 1 launch + 2 mid-period email sequences (5 emails total)
SMS template (2 alerts, copy variations)
Lead capture + CRM integration (auto-feed emails/phone to client CRM or spreadsheet)
Daily performance dashboard (7 days) + post-campaign ROI analysis (cost-per-lead, lead quality, conversion rates)
